# Summary

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: drain smells like sewage. SEO title: "Why Your Drain Smells Like Sewage (Fixes) (41 chars)".
- Quick answer: Most common cause is a dry P-trap (water evaporates fast in Arizona heat), then biofilm buildup, vent problems, or a sewer line issue.
- Links: drain cleaning pillar, garbage disposals pillar, sewer line pillar, sewer-backup and slow-sink siblings, contact. External: CDC/ATSDR hydrogen sulfide statement.
- Verification block: keyphrase placements, single H1, no em dashes, cannibalization and Arizona localization all marked PASS; Kim to confirm internal URLs and .gov links load in a browser.

- Not published under this slug. The topic overlaps the August cluster pillar `/blog/drain-smells-backs-up-summer/` (published 2026-07-31), so publishing this draft now would risk cannibalization.
